## Requirements (from the contract §In-scope)
1. Run the 34-detector §33.2 catalog over the real (Round-6-materialized) spine → materialise the
   **research queue** (tasks from contradictions/gaps/renewals), with geo queues (§33.5) + anti-abuse
   (§33.6, per-subject rate limit + dedup) intact; every generated task cites its trigger.
2. Generate **records requests** from the gaps/contradictions (statute-templated, §33.4/§36) —
   **DRAFTED, NOT SENT**; sending is an explicit operator gate (external side effect; never auto-fire).
3. Surface the research queue on the public surface (zero-JS, WCAG 2.2 AA) — "what SIG is looking at
   next".

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)
- [ ] the detector catalog runs over the real spine → a real research queue (tasks with dispositions +
  geo queues + anti-abuse) *(deterministic + live-gated)*
- [ ] records requests are auto-drafted from gaps/contradictions (statute-templated); sending is
  operator-gated, never auto *(deterministic)*
- [ ] `make check` + `make test-db` + build-memory green *(deterministic)*

## Cross-cutting invariants
Anti-abuse on task/detector generation (rate/dedup/geo-abuse); NO external side effect
(records-request send) without an operator gate — DRAFT only; append-only; every generated task cites
its trigger; never a total (§32); Part VIII. Reuse-not-reimplement (SIG-ENG-035): the `tasks/` detector
engine (`catalog`/`spec`/`lifecycle`), `records_request.py`, `geographic.py`, the RateLimiter +
`poisoning.py` anti-abuse, and the Round-6 materialized read seams
(`reconcile.materialize.read_materialized_contradictions`/`read_materialized_edges`,
`inference.materialize.read_materialized_coverage`) are CONSUMED.

## Plan
Exploration confirmed: the §33 engine (`catalog`/`spec`/`lifecycle`/`geographic`/`poisoning`/
`records_request`) is IN-MEMORY only; the `research_task` DDL + the two READ seams
(`api.store_pg._persisted_tasks`, `exports.spine_export` → `web/research_queue.json`) + the web page
(`research-queue.astro`/`research-queue.ts`/`data.ts`) all exist. The **missing piece is the WRITE
path**: a detector-run that reads the Round-6 materialized graph and INSERTs deduped `research_task`
rows. P29.2 fills exactly that, reusing everything.

- **Engine (additive):** `lifecycle.ResearchTask` gains optional `trigger_kind`/`trigger_ref`;
  `TaskPool.generate(..., trigger_kind=, trigger_ref=)` stamps them (every generated task cites its
  trigger). Back-compat (defaults None).
- **New sqitch change `research_task_trigger`** (dep [graph_annotations]): nullable `trigger_kind`,
  `trigger_ref` on `research_task` (additive/back-compat — mirrors the P28.x `input_digest` adds).
- **`tasks/detect.py`** (pure, no DB): routes the materialized detector outputs → catalog tasks —
  contradictions via `CONTRADICTION_TASK_MAP` (SIG-TASK-004), `not_researched`/`searched_not_found`
  coverage gaps → `missing_contract`(records-obtainable predicate) else `coverage_hole`, stale
  `configured_access` edges → `sharing_snapshot_stale` (renewals) — through `TaskPool` (dedup
  SIG-TASK-007 + `RateLimiter` anti-abuse SIG-TASK-013), ordered by `GeographicQueue` (geo queues,
  non-exclusive). Each task cites its trigger. Records-request DRAFTS (statute-templated, §36) for the
  records-requester/document-reviewer tasks via `records_law_for` + `template_library` — DRAFTED, NOT
  SENT (no `Filer`/consent fabricated, no transmit path exists or is added). Honest empty-degrade.
- **`tasks/research_pg.py`** (DB glue, reuse seams): `read_materialized_inputs` (col-guarded degrade
  like `spine_export`) via `reconcile.materialize.read_materialized_{contradictions,edges}` +
  `inference.materialize.read_materialized_coverage`; `materialize_research_queue` (INSERT ON CONFLICT
  (task_type,subject_id) DO NOTHING — append-only, idempotent +0, trigger stamped; skips
  non-entity subjects honestly); `*_from_dsn`. Jurisdiction/agency resolver over `entity_identifier`.
- **CLI:** `sig-tasks detect --dsn … [--role R] [--out DIR] [--now ISO]` → JSON summary; `--out` writes
  `<out>/records_requests.json` (drafts). Research queue reaches the web via the existing
  `spine_export` → `research_queue.json`.
- **Export + web (additive, col-guarded):** extend the `research_tasks` export SELECT + `_research_queue`
  with the trigger (guarded so a pre-P29.2 spine still exports); `ResearchTaskCard.trigger?` +
  render "Triggered by …" on `research-queue.astro` (zero-JS).
- **Deps:** add `sig-reconcile` to `tasks` (direct import of the reconcile read seams).
- **Deferrals:** `D-R7.2-DETECTORS` (V, OPEN, BL-057) live-over-hosted; the records-request SEND
  operator gate (P, BL-057). Ticket Gate status block updated.

## Evidence report
The self-feeding accountability loop is turned on over the real (Round-6-materialized) spine and proven
over real PG18+PostGIS: the built §33.2 detector catalog is run over the materialized detector outputs —
each §31 contradiction routes to the catalog task that resolves it (SIG-TASK-004,
`CONTRADICTION_TASK_MAP`), each `not_researched`/`searched_not_found` §32 coverage gap routes to a
records-requester or field task, and each stale `configured_access` §29.7 edge routes to a renewal task —
and the resulting **research queue** is minted through the real `TaskPool` (so `(task_type, subject)`
dedup SIG-TASK-007 and a per-subject `RateLimiter` SIG-TASK-013 apply) and ordered by the real
`GeographicQueue` (priority, never exclusivity, §33.5). The queue is persisted as durable, **append-only,
idempotent (+0)** `research_task` rows (new sqitch change `research_task_trigger`; `ON CONFLICT
(task_type, subject_id) DO NOTHING`), and **every generated task cites its trigger** (`trigger_kind`/
`trigger_ref` = the materialized row that fired the detector). Records requests are auto-**DRAFTED** from
the records-oriented tasks — statute-templated with the correct per-jurisdiction citation and the current
proven template (reusing `records_request.py`), with residency routing to local filers for the six
restricted states — and are **NEVER SENT**: no consenting filer is fabricated, no transmit path exists or
is added, `records_requests_sent` is always 0, and the actual SEND is an operator-gated deferral
(D-R7.2-SEND). The queue reaches the public surface through the existing `spine_export` →
`web/research_queue.json` → `research-queue.astro`, now carrying the trigger citation ("Triggered by …",
zero-JS, WCAG 2.2 AA). The whole §33 engine + `records_request.py` + `geographic.py` + the anti-abuse +
the Round-6 read seams are CONSUMED, not re-implemented (SIG-ENG-035); `tasks/detect.py` is pure
orchestration. `make check` exit 0, `make test-db` 180 passed, `npm --prefix web run check` exit 0 both
modes. The live-over-hosted detector run is honestly deferred (D-R7.2-DETECTORS, BL-057) with the exact
re-run command — no fabricated hosted count. No new ADR (the semantics are consumed; ADR-099 covers the
materialize-at-scale posture).
